home.heroTitlePre: Find trusted cleaners or cleaning jobs
home.heroSubtitle: Alieni connects households and businesses with independent cleaners, and cleaners with flexible work.
home.householdsText: Find reliable cleaners quickly and easily.
home.cleanersText: Get cleaning jobs in your area.
home.businessesText: Post a cleaning job for your office, shop or rental.
home.howStep1Text: Browse profiles of cleaners near you, free of charge.
home.howStep2Text: Plan a meeting, chat safely and discuss what you need.
home.howStep3Text: Got a deal? Only then you pay €14.95 per month per active connection — cancel any time.
home.sampleDataNotice: Sample data — real profiles arrive at launch.

footer.notice: Alieni is an advertising marketplace. Cleaners are independent and not employed by Alieni; users make their own arrangements.

meeting.freeNote: Free and without obligation. You only pay once you both confirm a deal.
meeting.title: Meet {name}
meeting.typeLabel: How would you like to meet?
meeting.slotLabel: Pick a moment from the availability
meeting.noSlots: This cleaner has not filled in any availability yet.
meeting.mandateNote: At launch, you add a payment method in this step (€0 — possibly a €0.01 iDEAL verification that is refunded automatically). You only pay €14.95 per month after you both confirm a deal.

chat.title: Messages
chat.empty: No conversations yet. Request a meeting with a cleaner to start chatting.
chat.maskingNotice: Phone numbers, email addresses and links are hidden automatically until you both confirm a deal. That keeps things safe and fair for everyone.
chat.willBeMasked: Note: contact details in this message will be hidden from the recipient.
chat.unlockedNotice: You are connected — contact details are now visible in the chat.

account.title: Account
account.intro: Log in or create an account to manage your messages, favourites and ad.

deal.question: Do you have a deal?
deal.explain: Only when you both confirm does the €14.95/month subscription start and contact details become visible. No deal? Then you pay nothing.
deal.waitingOther: Your confirmation is in! Waiting for {name} to confirm…
deal.activeText: Contact details are now visible. The €14.95/month subscription (incl. 21% VAT) has started — cancel any time, effective at the end of the current month.
deal.endedNote: Connection ended — the subscription stops at the end of the current month. You can always look for a new cleaner.
deal.noMatchNote: Not a match — nothing was charged. Feel free to keep looking for another cleaner.

admin.openReports: {count, plural, =0 {No open reports} one {# open report} other {# open reports}}
admin.reporterUpdateNote: Every action automatically sends the reporter a status update (DSA) and is written to the audit log.

admin.settingBusinessModel: Business pricing model (to be decided — configurable)

admin.settingRateFloorHint: The statutory minimum wage changes every 1 January and 1 July — update this then.

admin.settingBusinessPricesHint: Changes apply to new subscriptions; existing customers keep their price until you notify them.

admin.vogFileDeleted: Reviewed: document deleted, only outcome and date kept.
admin.bizMrrNote: Only active subscriptions count. Billing happens at the end of each month by SEPA direct debit.
admin.linenText: Once the add-on is on, kits per checkout appear here for the linen partner. Export follows with the partner integration.
admin.emNote: Booking fees are only charged on acceptance. Expired requests cost nothing.

media.title: Site photos
media.intro: Upload the photos for the homepage and the business pages yourself. They are resized and stored as WebP automatically. After saving, the new photo is live right away.
media.notConfigured: Uploads work once the Supabase keys are set (they already are on Vercel). In this demo you only see the bundled photos.
media.where_hero-cleaner: Shown next to the headline on the homepage (portrait, 3:4).
media.chooseFile: Choose a photo (JPG, PNG or WebP, max. 10 MB)
media.hint: Resized to max. {px} px wide. Best ratio: {aspect}.
media.error_bad_image: This file could not be read as an image.
media.error_not_admin: Only the administrator can change photos.

jobs.title: Cleaning jobs
jobs.intro: Jobs from businesses — respond with your rate and a short message.
jobs.postIntro: For offices, shops, hospitality and rentals. Cleaners respond with their rate; you choose.
jobs.areaNote: Only the postcode area is visible — you share the exact address with the cleaner yourself.
jobs.sent: Response sent ({rate}/hr). The business sees your response and will contact you via chat.
jobs.postcodeError: Enter a valid Dutch postcode (e.g. 1012 AB).
jobs.descriptionError: Describe the job in at least a few sentences.
jobs.payNote: Posting jobs is free. You only pay a fixed monthly fee once you confirm a deal with a cleaner — never commission.
jobs.savedText: Accounts and payments are not active yet. Your job is stored locally and goes live once we launch.

business.heroTitle: A fixed monthly price. No commission. You choose the cleaner.
business.heroText: One simple monthly fee per listing, room or location. You pay the cleaner directly, at their own business rate. Alieni earns only the fixed fee.
business.noCommission: Cleaners keep 100% of their rate — no commission.
business.typesText: Each sector has its own unit and price. Searching, posting jobs and meeting cleaners is free.
business.pricesNote: All prices excl. 21% VAT (BTW). The monthly fee only starts when you confirm your first deal with a cleaner.
business.how1Text: 4 short steps: account, business type, number of units, addresses. You see your monthly price before paying anything.
business.how2Text: Search cleaners near your locations or post a free job. Chat, meet, confirm the deal together.
business.how3Text: From your first deal: one invoice at the end of each month, collected automatically. Cancel any time.
business.billingText: At the end of each month you receive one invoice (with VAT breakdown, PDF + CSV) for that month. The amount is collected by SEPA direct debit. The first month is pro-rated from the day of your first deal. If you change your number of units, the new amount applies from the next month.
business.signupIntro: Done in 2 minutes. You see your monthly price before paying anything — and you only pay after your first deal.
business.pickType: What kind of business are you?
business.payLater: Nothing to pay now. The monthly fee only starts when you confirm your first deal with a cleaner, and is invoiced monthly in arrears.
business.addressesIntro: Addresses of your {units} — needed to find cleaners nearby. Only you and the cleaner you make a deal with see the exact address.
business.moreUnitsLater: You can add the remaining {count} addresses in your dashboard.
business.noAccount: No business account yet. Signing up takes 2 minutes.
business.billingActive: Billing active — you receive your invoice at the end of the month; the amount is collected automatically.
business.billingNotStarted: Billing not started — it only starts at your first confirmed deal. Searching and posting jobs is free.
business.demoNote: Demo mode — your details are stored locally on this device until accounts are live.
business.cancelledNote: Cancelled — stops at the end of the current month.
business.invoicesText: At the end of each month your invoice (PDF) with VAT breakdown appears here. The amount is collected automatically. If a direct debit fails, we pause the connection and ask you to update your payment method.

calendar.title: Calendar & checkout cleaning
calendar.introAirbnb: Paste the iCal link from Airbnb, Booking.com or VRBO per listing. Alieni reads the bookings every 30 minutes and creates a cleaning slot at every checkout automatically.
calendar.introHotel: Link an iCal feed or add room turnovers per day manually. Your connected cleaner sees the slots weeks ahead.
calendar.icalHint: In Airbnb: Calendar → Availability → Sync calendars → Export calendar → copy the link.
calendar.linked: Linked — slots appear below (demo: sample bookings).
calendar.noSlots: No slots yet. Link a calendar or add turnovers.
calendar.syncNote: Not reserved 48 hours before checkout? You and your cleaner get a reminder and the slot is also offered to other connected cleaners.
calendar.cleanerIntro: Checkout cleans at businesses you are connected with. Reserve slots weeks ahead and mark them done when finished.
calendar.cleanerEmpty: No slots yet. Once you are connected with an Airbnb host or hotel, their checkouts appear here.
calendar.icalUnsafe: Only https links from known calendar providers (Airbnb, Booking.com, VRBO, Google Calendar, …) are supported.

emergency.title: I need a cleaner today
emergency.intro: Your request goes to emergency cleaners nearby who can come today. The first to accept gets it. If nobody accepts within your window, the request expires automatically and you pay nothing.
emergency.window: Time window today (from – to) and hours
emergency.tasksPlaceholder: E.g. whole flat after a party: kitchen, bathroom, floors, rubbish.
emergency.windowError: The end time must be after the start time.
emergency.feeNote: Fixed emergency booking fee: {fee} {btw} — only if a cleaner accepts. You pay the cleaner directly at their emergency rate.
emergency.addressNote: Your address is only visible to the cleaner who accepts and is deleted 7 days after the job.
emergency.searchingText: Emergency cleaners nearby have been notified. You'll hear as soon as someone accepts. Expires automatically at {until} if nobody responds.
emergency.honestNote: We only show 'booked' once a cleaner has actually accepted.
emergency.acceptedText: {cleaner} is coming today. Emergency rate: {rate} per hour, paid directly to the cleaner.
emergency.feeCharged: Booking fee {fee} is now charged to your payment method.
emergency.cleanerIntro: Today's requests near you. First to accept gets the job — at your emergency rate.
emergency.openTitle: {count, plural, =0 {No open requests} one {# open request} other {# open requests}}
emergency.openEmpty: Quiet right now. You'll be notified of new emergency requests near you.
emergency.acceptedByYou: Accepted — the client has been notified.

airbnb.heroText: Paste your Airbnb, Booking.com or VRBO calendar. Every checkout becomes a cleaning slot your regular cleaner reserves weeks ahead. No more Sunday-night messages.
airbnb.example: Example: {units} listings = {fee} per month excl. VAT.
airbnb.benefit1Text: We read your bookings every 30 minutes. Turnover days become cleaning slots by themselves.
airbnb.benefit2Text: Your connected cleaner reserves slots ahead; nobody 48 hours before checkout? You get a heads-up and we offer the slot to others.
airbnb.benefit3Text: Per listing per month, no commission on the cleaning. You pay the cleaner directly.
airbnb.demoCaption: Your dashboard after linking a calendar.

hotel.heroTitle: Room turnovers handled, a few euros per room.
hotel.heroText: Link your channel manager via iCal or enter expected turnovers daily. Your cleaners see weeks ahead and mark each room done.
hotel.example: Example: {units} rooms = {fee} per month excl. VAT.
hotel.benefit1Text: A fixed price per guest room. Small B&B or 60 rooms: it scales with you.
hotel.benefit2Text: No iCal? Enter the number of turnovers per day — done in 10 seconds.
hotel.benefit3Text: Your cleaner marks each turnover done, optionally with a photo of the made-up room.
hotel.demoHeading: Hotel De Linde — turnovers this week
hotel.demoCaption: Your dashboard: iCal slots and manual turnovers side by side.

restaurant.heroTitle: Clean before the first guest. Every day.
restaurant.heroText: Post a job with your closing hours; cleaners who accept hospitality respond with their rate. You choose, meet, and confirm the deal in the app.
restaurant.example: Example: {units} location = {fee} per month excl. VAT.
restaurant.benefit1Text: Daily, weekly or one-off — before opening or after closing, you set the times.
restaurant.benefit2Text: Cleaners respond with their business hourly rate (typically €25–35). No surprises.
restaurant.benefit3Text: No commission, no contract: cancel any time at the end of the month.
restaurant.demoHeading: Brasserie Zuid — responses to your job
restaurant.demoCaption: What a posted job with responses looks like.

office.heroTitle: A regular cleaner for your office, shop or practice.
office.heroText: Describe what needs doing and when. Cleaners with a KvK number respond; after meeting you confirm the deal together. Then everything runs automatically.
office.example: Example: {units} location = {fee} per month excl. VAT.
office.benefit1Text: Every business cleaner on Alieni works with a KvK number and keeps 100% of the rate.
office.benefit2Text: One invoice at the end of the month with VAT breakdown, PDF and CSV for your bookkeeping.
office.benefit3Text: Chain of shops or several practices? Add locations; the price is per location.
office.demoHeading: Kapsalon Glans — responses to your job
office.demoCaption: What a posted job with responses looks like.

school.heroTitle: Only cleaners with an approved VOG.
school.heroText: Schools and childcare centres see only cleaners whose VOG Alieni has checked and approved — no older than 12 months. The document itself stays private.
school.example: Example: {units} site = {fee} per month excl. VAT.
school.benefit1Text: Cleaners upload their VOG; we review it. You only see the badge.
school.benefit2Text: Post jobs for after school hours or holidays and build a lasting relationship.
school.benefit3Text: One fixed price per site per month. Billed in arrears, with VAT breakdown.
school.demoCaption: What search looks like for schools: only VOG-checked cleaners.
